{{Recipesummary|category=Rice recipes|servings=4|time=1 hour|difficulty=3| Energy = 360 kcal}}

{{Recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of China|Cuisine of China]]

==Ingredients==

=== Pork ===
* 1 piece (750 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) boneless [[Cookbook:Pork#Loin|pork loin]], cut into 30 pieces

* 50 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbeque sauce]]
* 15 ml light [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy sauce]]
* 30 ml [[Cookbook:Hoisin Sauce|hoisin sauce]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2½ tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

=== Fried rice ===
* 6½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 5 tbsp [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]]
* 7 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] piece of [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]], minced
* 5 red [[Cookbook:Chilli|chillies]], minced
* 6 [[Cookbook:Scallion|scallion]], cut into 2 cm pieces
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], mixed
* 1000 g cooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 4 tbsp salted [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 tbsp chicken [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|bouillon powder]]
* 1½ tbsp [[Cookbook:Oyster sauce|oyster sauce]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 20 g [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeño]]

=== Garnish ===
* Shredded [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]]
* [[Cookbook:Tomato|Tomato]]
* [[Cookbook:Pickle|Pickles]]
* Shredded [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]]
* [[Cookbook:Cucumber|Cucumber]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], cooked into an [[Cookbook:Omelette|omelette]] and sliced 1 cm thick (as garnish)

==Procedure==

=== '''Pork''' ===
# Combine the barbecue sauce, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, and salt to make the marinade.
# Place the pork into the sauce mixture. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 25 minutes. Make sure the sauce in the bowl is really absorbed.
# Transfer the pork to a baking pan, and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 20 minutes at {{#invoke:temperature|c|200}}. When finished, put the pork onto a plate.

=== '''Fried rice''' ===
# Heat the olive oil and sesame oil in a medium [[Cookbook:Wok|wok]]. Fry the garlic, red chillies, ginger and scallion, then stir briefly for 1 minute. Add the mixed egg and rice.
# Add the grilled pork, salted soy sauce, chicken powder, oyster sauce, salt and jalapeño. Stir until mixed.
# Serve hot with garnishes.
